summary: Abbott has repeatedly used Texas executive power to shield Israel and suppress Palestinian justice advocacy. In 2021 he declared "Texas stands with Israel" as a "friend and partner." In 2025 he threatened to defund San Marcos over a ceasefire resolution, calling it "antisemitic," and in 2024 directed state universities to define antisemitism in free-speech policies with punishments for antisemitic rhetoric, citing the BDS ban. In January 2026 he urged revocation of CAIR Texas's nonprofit status.
